title: Maximum of Two Numbers using Ternary

content.problemStatement: Find the maximum of two inputs using ternary operator.

sampleTestCases.explanation: Input '120 98' produces expected output '' following problem rules.
Input '12 34' produces expected output '' following problem rules.

solution.approach: Find maximum of two numbers using the ternary operator (a > b ? a : b).
solution.notes: Ensure edge case and standard I/O format handling.
solution.editorial: Evaluate the condition a > b; if true, return a; otherwise return b.

hints: The ternary operator has the syntax: condition ? exprIfTrue : exprIfFalse.
